[ROLE "TASK Maker"] Let’s refine the structure of our **Project Management Workflow Tabbed UI** to ensure it meets all the necessary requirements and provides a seamless user experience. Here’s a detailed breakdown:

### Overview Tab
#### Project Summary
- **Title**: Name of the project.
- **Description**: Brief overview of the project.
- **Start Date**: When the project began.
- **End Date**: Expected completion date.
- **Status**: Current status (e.g., In Progress, On Hold, Completed).

#### Key Stats
- **Number of Tasks**: Total number of tasks.
- **Number of Team Members**: Total number of team members involved.
- **Completed Tasks**: Number of tasks completed.
- **Pending Tasks**: Number of tasks pending.
- **Overdue Tasks**: Number of tasks past their due dates.

#### Progress Bars
- **Overall Project Progress**: Visual representation of overall project completion percentage.
- **Task Completion**: Breakdown of task completion by category or phase.
- **Milestone Progress**: Progress towards key milestones.

### Tools Tab
#### List of Tools
- **Name**: Name of the tool.
- **Description**: Detailed description of the tool’s functionality.
- **Requirements**: Hardware and software requirements.
- **Properties**: Additional attributes or features of the tool.
- **Expected Outcomes**: What the tool should achieve.
- **Responsible Role**: The role responsible for the tool.

#### Search Bar
- Filter tools by name, responsible role, etc.

### Tasks Tab
#### List of Tasks
- **Title**: Title of the task.
- **Description**: Detailed description of the task.
- **Prerequisites**: Any tasks that need to be completed before this one.
- **Expected Outcome**: What the task should achieve.
- **Status**: Current status (e.g., Not Started, In Progress, Completed).
- **Priority**: Priority level (High, Medium, Low).
- **Due Date**: Deadline for the task.
- **Responsible Role**: The role responsible for the task.

#### Search Bar
- Filter tasks by title, status, priority, responsible role, etc.

#### Sorting Feature
- Sort tasks by status, priority, due date, etc.

### Deliverables Tab
#### list of Deliverables
- **Integration Report**: Summary of the integration process.
- **Date**: Date of delivery.
- **Summary**: Brief summary of the deliverable.
- **Issues**: Any issues encountered during integration.
- **Next Steps**: Actions to be taken after integration.
- **Quality Checks**: Results of quality assurance tests.

#### search Bar
- filter deliverables by integration report, issues, etc.

#### Sorting Feature
- Sort deliverables by date, status, etc.

### Team Tab
#### List of Team Members
- **Name**: Name of the team member.
- **Role**: Role within the project.
- **Tasks Assigned**: List of tasks assigned to the member.
- **Completion Status**: Percentage of tasks completed by the member.

#### search Bar
- filter team members by role, tasks, etc.

#### Sorting Feature
- Sort team members by tasks, completion status, etc.

### Additional Features
- **Notifications**: Real-time notifications for task assignments, updates, and deadlines.
- **Collaboration Tools**: Integration with communication platforms (e.g., Slack, Microsoft Teams).
- **Customization**: Allow users to customize views and settings according to their preferences.

By structuring our UI in this way, we ensure that all aspects of the project are easily accessible and manageable, promoting transparency and efficiency throughout the project lifecycle. 

[ROLE "Code Generator"] I will start working on the initial setup for the UI components and ensure they are integrated with our backend systems. 

[ROLE "Designer"] I’ll begin designing the wireframes and visual elements to align with our brand and user experience standards. 

[ROLE "Graph Explorer"] I will focus on integrating the data flow and ensuring real-time synchronization across all tabs.
